nodes.name: When Called
nodes.notes: Inputs: model output (completion, model, cost_pln) + routing fields (clickup_task_id, reviewer_user_id, triggering_comment_id, web_sources).

nodes.name: Build Comment
nodes.notes: Converts model markdown -> ClickUp Quill-delta ops + @-mention + footer + web sources section. Reads all inputs from When Called trigger.

nodes.name: Is @mention?
nodes.notes: True (triggering_comment_id set) -> reply in-thread. False (autonomous trigger) -> new top-level comment.

nodes.name: Post Reply
nodes.notes: Reply path for @mention triggers. onError=continueErrorOutput -> Alert Reply Failed, then fallback to Post Draft Comment.

nodes.name: Alert Reply Failed

value.message: Nie udało się odpowiedzieć w wątku — fallback na nowy komentarz najwyższego poziomu.

nodes.notes: WARN when replying in-thread fails. Run continues via Post Draft Comment fallback.

nodes.name: Post Draft Comment
nodes.notes: Posts agent output as a new top-level comment. Used for autonomous triggers or as Post Reply fallback.

value.message: Nie udało się opublikować wersji roboczej (komentarza) na zadaniu CU.

nodes.name: Set Status Zakonczono
nodes.notes: Sets [AI] Status agenta -> 'Zakończono' after draft comment is posted.

value.message: Nie udało się zaktualizować pola CU '[AI] Status agenta' na Zakończono.

nodes.name: Record Artifact

options.queryReplacement: ={{ [ $('When Called').first().json.clickup_task_id, ($('Post Draft Comment').isExecuted && $('Post Draft Comment').first().json.id) ? $('Post Draft Comment').first().json.id : ($('Post Reply').isExecuted ? $('Post Reply').first().json.id : '') ] }}

nodes.notes: ADR-044 erasure-readiness: writes the posted ClickUp comment id onto the task's latest agent_runs row. Side branch off Set Status success — cannot affect the already-complete reply/status. CTE always returns one row (target_id, updated 0/1) so a 0-row UPDATE is detectable, not a silent 0-item drop.

nodes.name: Recorded?
nodes.notes: True: clickup_comment_id written (updated=1) -> done. False: no matching agent_runs row (updated=0) -> WARN.

nodes.name: Alert Record Artifact

value.message: Nie zapisano clickup_comment_id na agent_runs (obserwowalność/erasure-readiness; odpowiedź i status zostały dostarczone).
value.details: =task={{ $('When Called').first().json.clickup_task_id }}; target_id={{ $('Record Artifact').first().json.target_id || 'null' }}; updated={{ $('Record Artifact').first().json.updated }}; err={{ ($json.error && (($json.error.message) || $json.error)) || 'none' }}

nodes.notes: WARN when the comment-id write found no row or errored. Defense-in-depth: a missing run row is also alerted upstream by Log Model Run. Posts to the Alerts task (disjoint from the answer task) so no webhook loop; does not block reply/status.
